source.check: every name read from the page image; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (nine divisions, two councillors each), polled 31 May 1911: contests in Camly, Lisleitrim, Lower Creggan and Newtownhamilton. Cullyhanna is not filed: three were nominated (James Donaghy, Patrick Green, Peter O'Hanlon) and there was no poll, but the withdrawal was not found. No party labels are printed. Returned unopposed.
